description_en: Transfers a call to a phone number using single-step or dual-step transfer
description_zh: 通话单\双步转交到电话
kebab_example: aliyun scsp transfer-call-to-phone --client-token 46c1341e-2648-447a-9b11-70b6a298d94d --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --account-name 123@123.com --caller 9065446 --callee 136098792 --call-id 7719786 --job-id 7719787 --connection-id 7719788 --hold-connection-id 0 --type 1 --is-single-transfer true --caller-phone example-string --callee-phone example-string --region cn-hangzhou
